name: Update Hydroponic Metrics
script:
# This script runs daily to update key metrics for the dashboard.

# --- Metric 1: Overdue Maintenance ---
maintenance_report_get_data = frappe.get_attr("agriculture_management.hydroponic.report.maintenance_and_compliance_schedule.maintenance_and_compliance_schedule.get_data")
filters = {"status": "Overdue"}
overdue_tasks = maintenance_report_get_data(filters)
overdue_count = len(overdue_tasks)

# --- Metric 2: Gross Profit of the Most Recently Completed Crop Cycle ---
profit = 0
# Get the profitability report's data function
profit_report_get_data = frappe.get_attr("agriculture_management.agriculture.report.crop_profitability_report.crop_profitability_report.get_data")

# Run the report with no filters to get all data
all_profit_data = profit_report_get_data({})

# Sort the data by harvest date to find the most recent one
if all_profit_data:
    # Sort in place by the 'harvest_date' key, newest first
    all_profit_data.sort(key=lambda x: x['harvest_date'], reverse=True)
    # Get the gross profit from the very first item in the sorted list
    profit = all_profit_data[0]['gross_profit']


# --- Update the KPI Document ---
# Fetch the specific KPI document by its unique name/ID.
# !! REPLACE 'KPI-2025-00001' WITH THE ID OF YOUR KPI DOCUMENT !!
kpi_doc_name = 'KPI-2025-00001' 
kpi_doc = frappe.get_doc("Hydroponic KPI", kpi_doc_name)

# Set the new values
kpi_doc.overdue_maintenance_tasks = overdue_count
kpi_doc.last_cycle_gross_profit = profit

# Save the document
kpi_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

# Optional: Log to the error log to confirm it ran
frappe.log_error(f"Hydroponic KPI updated. Overdue: {overdue_count}, Last Profit: {profit}", "Update Hydroponic Metrics")
